messages:
Sam: morning — quick standup. Did: rotated autoscaler patch to reduce queue spikes, triggered a small canary. Blockers: still seeing occasional 504s on the embedding route. Today: follow up on kv-evict tuning PR + help oncall if alerts persist.
Priya: ack — saw 504s around 02:12 UTC, linked logs here: https://logs.internal/trace/abc123. I'm looking at batcher queue metrics now.
Lin: thanks. Can you paste the query you used for the `avg_slo_latency` metric? If we need to bump alert thresholds temporarily, we should annotate the runbook.
Priya: query (quick): `sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/embed"}[1m]))` — will attach a chart after digging.
oncall-bot: ALERT: embedding-route-5xx high (threshold: 0.5%) — 3 occurrences in last 10m. Pager: @Sam, @Marcus.
Marcus: on it, running `kubectl logs -l app=embed-service --since=15m` to check pod logs. ETA ~8m.
Sam: quick note: I added a temporary alert suppress for 15m while we confirm root cause — documented in the runbook comment: https://docs.internal/runbooks/embedding-route (added comment).
Priya: prefer annotating instead of suppressing, suggest `escalation:manual` in runbook, but ok for 15m if we log action and link rollback plan.
Lin: filing a short postmortem draft even if this doesn't escalate. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/432 (runbook drift + annotations).
Marcus: found a hot path — KV eviction spikes coincide with the recent model-quantize rollout (quantize-2026-03.1). Rolling back quantize on canary now.
Sam: good catch. After rollback, keep autoscaler target conservative (0.5) for 30m to avoid churn.
Priya: seeing latency drop on canary nodes already (dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/embed/xyz).
Marcus: rollback complete on canary. Will watch production for 20m and report.
Sam: if prod stable after 20m, we keep change and create follow-up ticket to do proper capacity and runtime testing before any future quantize rollouts.
Lin: assigned ticket SRE-3372 to Sam + Marcus + Priya (will add acceptance criteria for capacity tests).
Sam: blocker lifted for now. Also need someone to review my PR for the alert debouncer small fix — @Priya? :pray:
Priya: can do after logs work, ETA ~25m :+1:
Marcus: reminder — update the runbook's `when-to-suppress` section to explicitly mention quantize/rollout-related noisy alerts.
Sam: noted, will update runbook after the postmortem is merged.
oncall-bot: NOTE: scheduled maintenance window today 04:00-04:30 UTC. Please avoid manual rollouts and suppressions then.
Priya: copying to pager schedule and posting a short note in #ops.
Lin: anything else? If not, we'll close the loop once Marcus confirms prod stable.
Marcus: will post final state in ~18m with full metrics and log snippets.
Sam: thanks all. Quick TL;DR: rollback quantize canary, 15m temporary suppress (logged), monitor 20m, open SRE-3372 for capacity tests, PRs: runbook + alert debouncer. :thumbsup:
